sentences.text: That completes Deck General and Safety.
Let me leave you with the habits that separate a professional from someone who just has a license.
Keep a log of every trip: passengers, weather, incidents, maintenance.
Keep your credential, your medical certificate and your drug-testing enrollment current.
Put the dates on a calendar.
A recreational policy usually won’t cover you the moment a passenger pays.
Use a pre-departure checklist on every single trip, even the hundredth.
And above all, know your limits and your boat’s limits, and cancel when conditions exceed them.
Will you lose that day’s money?
And your customers will book again, because you’re the captain who brought them home.
Now take the lesson check, then the Deck General quiz, until you’re scoring eighty percent or better.
